title: RFC 8724 SCHC: complete implementation as standalone crate
description: Generic SCHC (Static Context Header Compression) implementation per RFC 8724. Design principle: compile small via const generics for M/N/T/tile parameters and feature flags for fragmentation modes. Dual MIT/Apache-2.0 license, no_std by default.
close_reason: Complete RFC 8724 implementation: compression engine + all 3 fragmentation modes (No-Ack, ACK-on-Error, Ack-Always). 4744 lines, const generics for compile-time optimization, all feature combinations build clean.
